name: seed-evidence-editorial-v1.4

provenance.method: Reference PDF visual inspection and approved five-slide hierarchy pilot; abstracted composition rules only

typography.note: Register all discovered faces in Artifact Tool's own skia-canvas registry. Measure the registered face, keep native text editable, and inspect actual final PPTX renders. No silent auto-shrink or omitted text.

layouts.composition: Prominent governing message and value proposition, with a supplied product visual and clearly disclosed stage or next milestone.
One dominant evidence object, metric or editorial statement; supporting interpretation has a separate role and smaller area. All sources remain visible or fully cited in notes.
A native comparison table or mapping with preserved dimensions; emphasize the comparison criterion and a separate interpretation, rather than arbitrary equal cards.
Source screenshot or photo as the primary product evidence, with native explanation beside it. Use an unequal-width source-bearing sequence when multiple stages are supplied.
A horizontal execution sequence with time, deliverables and decision gates; highlight the final supplied stage without implying unsupported conversion rates.
Team contribution or long-term vision left, one owned photo or three compact outcomes right; clear next milestone.

visual_brief_variants.evidence_focus: Primary evidence dominates; support areas follow content length and role. Qualitative evidence never becomes an invented numerical chart.
visual_brief_variants.comparison_focus: Native table or mapping with aligned criteria and an interpretation column. Wide matrices use a full-width composition.
visual_brief_variants.product_hero: Original input screenshot/photo or labeled fictional design asset plus native explanatory text. Decode its actual aspect ratio: portrait images use a narrower panel while retaining physical height, never stretching the screenshot. Preserve captions, source and original media.
visual_brief_variants.market_layers: Layered arithmetic with formula, result, scope and basis. Indentation shows scope sequence, never proportional market area.
visual_brief_variants.timeline_focus: Time, deliverables and advancement gates on one execution sequence. The last stage is emphasized.
visual_brief_variants.team_focus: Role, named experience and execution contribution, with the existing team distinguished visually from supplementary capability.
visual_brief_variants.cover_focus: A clear governing statement on the left and a full-height supplied image at right, with remaining context beneath the statement. A spacious dark composition by default.

reference_composition.product_journey: Four evidence-bearing stages with title, actual product image when available, action, and detailed result. Reference slide 8.
reference_composition.milestone_roadmap: Four periods with concrete deliverables and advancement gates, optionally followed by a schedule metric and validation condition. Reference slide 17.
reference_composition.roadmap_funding: Legacy layout alias for four periods and advancement gates with a supporting context band.
reference_composition.market_model: Three addressable-market calculations with populations, price assumptions, formulas and result; external context in a right column. Reference slide 13.
reference_composition.competition_matrix: Native table retaining all comparison dimensions and named alternatives; separate strategic implication.
reference_composition.problem_solution: Problem, intervention and proof in aligned rows, with actual evidence or a qualification alongside.
reference_composition.team_evidence: Each person's role, verified experience and concrete execution contribution; remaining capability gap below.
reference_composition.evidence_board: A dominant native chart/table or source image with complementary evidence and interpretation. Two media types may coexist.

rights_note: Style tokens and layout ideas only. Reference photos, screenshots, logos, company claims and font binaries are not redistributed. Verify font licensing from the font project before installing or bundling.
